name: Real GRDP per capita (BPS Seri 2010)
definition: BPS-published per-capita GRDP at constant 2010 prices under the source Seri 2010 methodology
m28_semantic_caution: Keep BPS source-published per-capita measure distinct from a repository-derived GRDP/population calculation; 2023 and 2024 provisional-status notes remain in provenance.

name: Morbidity rate
definition: Share of population meeting the BPS Susenas morbidity definition for the source reference period
m28_semantic_caution: Do not reinterpret self-reported/source-defined morbidity as diagnosed disease prevalence; preserve Susenas definition and source notes.

name: JKN membership coverage
definition: Share of population covered by Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional under the BPS source definition including BPJS Mandiri and BPJS PBI
m28_semantic_caution: Administrative/coverage membership is not healthcare utilization access quality or effective service coverage.

name: Internet access age 5+ in previous 3 months
definition: Share of persons age 5 years and older who accessed the internet within the previous three months under the BPS Susenas definition
m28_semantic_caution: Age universe and three-month recall period are part of the indicator identity and must not be dropped.

name: Adequate sanitation access
definition: Share of households with access to adequate sanitation under the BPS Susenas source definition
m28_semantic_caution: Preserve BPS adequate-sanitation definition and methodology revisions by source year; no missing year is zero.

name: Adequate drinking-water access
definition: Share of households with access to an adequate drinking-water source under the BPS SDGs-aligned definition used from 2019
m28_semantic_caution: 2018 is excluded from the SDGs-aligned regime; 2019-2020 are explicitly backcast estimates and must not be relabeled observed; adequate source is not synonymous with piped-water service.

name: Dependency ratio (LF SP2020 / projection regime)
definition: Dependents relative to working-age population under the BPS LF SP2020 anchor and 2020-2035 projection regime
m28_semantic_caution: 2020 is an LF SP2020 anchor while 2021-2024 are projection estimates; never relabel projection years as observed.
